clues.name: Iceland
clues: This country sits on two tectonic plates.
It produces much of its electricity from renewable sources.
You can find black-sand beaches and powerful geysers here.
Its capital is Reykjavík.
It is a Nordic island famous for volcanoes and glaciers.

clues.name: Japan
clues: This country has thousands of islands.
Its traditional art includes origami and ukiyo-e.
Its high-speed rail network is called the Shinkansen.
Mount Fuji is one of its best-known landmarks.
Its capital is Tokyo.

clues.name: Brazil
clues: This country shares borders with most countries on its continent.
A large part of the Amazon rainforest lies within its borders.
Its official language differs from most neighboring countries.
It is famous for samba and Carnival in Rio.
It is the largest country in South America.

clues.name: Morocco
clues: This country has coastlines on two major bodies of water.
Its landscapes include part of the Atlas Mountains.
Marrakech and Fez are famous cities here.
It is in northwestern Africa, near Spain.
Its capital is Rabat.

clues.name: New Zealand
clues: This country has no native land snakes.
It was one of the first countries to grant women the right to vote nationally.
The Māori are its Indigenous Polynesian people.
It is known for kiwis, both birds and people.
Its capital is Wellington, and it lies southeast of Australia.

clues.name: Egypt
clues: This country is home to one of the world’s oldest civilizations.
Most of its population lives close to one major river.
Its ancient writing system used hieroglyphs.
The Great Sphinx and Giza pyramids are here.
Its capital is Cairo.

clues.name: Switzerland
clues: This country has four national languages.
It is landlocked and has a long tradition of neutrality.
It is famous for precision watches and chocolate.
The Alps cover much of its territory.
Its capital is Bern.

clues.name: Thailand
clues: This country was historically known as Siam.
It is the only Southeast Asian country that avoided formal European colonization.
Its cuisine often blends sweet, sour, salty and spicy flavors.
Its famous islands include Phuket and Ko Samui.
Its capital is Bangkok.

clues.name: Canada
clues: This country has more lakes than any other country.
It has two official languages at the federal level.
Its national flag features a maple leaf.
Toronto, Vancouver and Montréal are major cities here.
It lies immediately north of the contiguous United States.

clues.name: Kenya
clues: The equator runs through this country.
It is home to the Maasai Mara wildlife reserve.
Swahili and English are official languages here.
It is known for long-distance runners and safaris.
Its capital is Nairobi.

clues.name: Greece
clues: This country has thousands of islands.
It is widely associated with the origins of democracy.
Its ancient myths feature Zeus and Athena.
The Acropolis overlooks its capital city.
Its capital is Athens.

clues.name: Peru
clues: This country has coastal desert, mountain and rainforest regions.
The ancient Nazca Lines can be found here.
It was at the heart of the Inca Empire.
Machu Picchu is one of its most famous sites.
Its capital is Lima.

clues.name: Vietnam
clues: This country has a long, narrow shape.
Its currency is the đồng.
Ha Long Bay is known for limestone islands.
Phở is a popular noodle soup from here.
Its capital is Hanoi.

clues.name: Norway
clues: This country has a long coastline with many deep inlets.
It has a large sovereign wealth fund funded by petroleum revenues.
The northern lights can be seen in its far north.
It is particularly famous for fjords.
Its capital is Oslo.

clues.name: Argentina
clues: This country stretches from subtropical regions to the far south.
It is home to a large portion of Patagonia.
Tango developed around its capital region.
Its flag has light-blue and white stripes with a sun.
Its capital is Buenos Aires.

clues.name: India
clues: This country has one of the world’s largest film industries.
Its geography includes parts of the Himalayas.
Hundreds of languages are spoken within its borders.
The Taj Mahal is located here.
Its capital is New Delhi.

clues.name: Portugal
clues: This country was a major maritime power during the Age of Exploration.
It includes the Atlantic island groups of Madeira and the Azores.
Fado is a traditional musical style here.
It shares its only land border with Spain.
Its capital is Lisbon.

clues.name: South Africa
clues: This country has three capital cities for different branches of government.
It has 12 official languages, including South African Sign Language.
Table Mountain is a well-known landmark.
It occupies the southern tip of the African continent.
Its largest city is Johannesburg.

clues.name: South Korea
clues: This country has an extensive high-speed internet infrastructure.
It is known for popular culture exports like K-pop.
Its alphabet is called Hangul.
It shares a heavily fortified border with North Korea.
Its capital is Seoul.

clues.name: Mexico
clues: This country is home to many ancient Maya archaeological sites.
Its cuisine is on UNESCO’s intangible cultural heritage list.
Chichén Itzá and Teotihuacán are famous sites here.
It borders the United States to the north.
Its capital is Mexico City.

clues.name: Indonesia
clues: This country spans three time zones.
It is among the world’s largest archipelagic nations.
Komodo dragons live on some of its islands.
Bali is one of its best-known tourist destinations.
Its national language is Indonesian.

clues.name: Turkey
clues: This country spans parts of Europe and Asia.
The ancient city of Troy was located in what is now this country.
Cappadocia is famous for unusual rock formations and hot-air balloons.
Istanbul lies on the Bosphorus strait.
Its capital is Ankara.

clues.name: Australia
clues: This country is both a sovereign state and occupies most of a continent.
It has the world’s largest coral reef system.
Kangaroos and koalas are native animals here.
Its major cities include Sydney and Melbourne.
Its capital is Canberra.

clues.name: Chile
clues: This country includes territory on Easter Island, also called Rapa Nui.
It is one of the longest north-to-south countries in the world.
The Atacama Desert occupies part of its north.
The Andes run along its eastern border.
Its capital is Santiago.

clues.name: Nepal
clues: This country uses a non-rectangular national flag.
It is landlocked between two very populous nations.
Many people trek in its Annapurna region.
Mount Everest sits on its border with China.
Its capital is Kathmandu.

clues.name: Spain
clues: This country includes island groups in the Mediterranean and Atlantic.
Many people here speak Catalan, Galician or Basque alongside Spanish.
Gaudí designed many buildings in Barcelona.
Flamenco is strongly associated with its Andalusia region.
Its capital is Madrid.

clues.name: Finland
clues: This country has two national languages: Finnish and Swedish.
It is nicknamed the land of a thousand lakes.
Saunas are an important cultural tradition.
It borders Sweden, Norway and Russia.
Its capital is Helsinki.

clues.name: Colombia
clues: This country touches both the Caribbean Sea and Pacific Ocean.
It is a major producer of coffee and emeralds.
The colorful city of Cartagena is a popular destination.
It lies in the northwestern part of South America.
Its capital is Bogotá.

clues.name: Ireland
clues: This country has an ancient tradition of Celtic storytelling.
It has two official languages, Irish and English.
Its landscapes earned it the nickname the Emerald Isle.
Its national symbol is often the shamrock.
Its capital is Dublin.

clues.name: Singapore
clues: This country is one of the few modern city-states.
It has four official languages.
Its main airport is famous for an indoor waterfall.
The Merlion is a well-known symbol here.
It lies at the southern end of the Malay Peninsula.

years.prompt: The United States declared independence.
The Berlin Wall fell.
World War II ended.
The first human landed on the Moon.
The Titanic sank.
The first modern Olympic Games were held in Athens.
India became independent from Britain.
The United Nations was founded.
South Africa held its first fully democratic national election.
The Euro was introduced as a currency for electronic payments.
The first FIFA World Cup took place in Uruguay.
The World Wide Web was made publicly available.
The Chernobyl nuclear disaster occurred.
The Soviet Union dissolved.
The first iPhone was released.
The first successful powered airplane flight took place.
The Suez Canal opened.
The Panama Canal opened.
The Great Fire of London happened.
The French Revolution began.
The fall of Constantinople happened.
The printing of the Gutenberg Bible was completed (approximately).
The first artificial satellite, Sputnik 1, was launched.
The first woman went to space.
The first country adopted women’s suffrage at the national level (New Zealand).
The Treaty of Versailles was signed.
The European Union was formally established by the Maastricht Treaty.
The first successful ascent of Mount Everest occurred.
The first transatlantic telephone cable entered service.
The first recorded circumnavigation expedition returned to Spain.
